newsitem.title: FRANCE: Franco-German economic talks set for March 12.
newsitem.headline: Franco-German economic talks set for March 12.

text.p: French and German finance ministers and central bank heads will meet in Lyon, France on March 12, the French finance ministry said on Friday.
French finance minister Jean Arthuis and Bank of France Governor Jean-Claude Trichet will meet their German counterparts Theo Waigel and Hans Tietmeyer.
The ministry declined to say what would be on the agenda.
At previous meetings, French and German officials have discussed economic issues and European economic and monetary union.
